# Flow: User Registration

This diagram was **generated as output** by Claude after reading `system-map.md`.
It shows how the registration flow uses the existing platform layers.

---

## Happy Path

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    actor User
    participant CDN     as CDN / Edge (CloudFront)
    participant Portal  as Customer Portal
    participant APIGW   as API Gateway
    participant Lambda  as user-register-api (Lambda)
    participant Cognito as Auth Platform (Cognito)
    participant DDB     as DynamoDB
    participant EB      as Event Bus (EventBridge)
    participant Notify  as Notification Platform

    User->>CDN: GET /register
    CDN->>Portal: serve registration page

    User->>Portal: fills form (name, email, password)
    Portal->>APIGW: POST /users/register
    APIGW->>Lambda: invoke (no auth — public endpoint)

    Lambda->>Lambda: validate input (Zod)
    Lambda->>Cognito: createUser(email, password)
    Cognito-->>Lambda: userId + confirmationCode

    Lambda->>DDB: PutItem — USER#{userId} PROFILE
    Lambda->>EB: emit user.account.created
    Lambda-->>APIGW: 201 Created { userId }
    APIGW-->>Portal: 201 response
    Portal-->>User: "Check your email to confirm"

    EB->>Notify: route user.account.created
    Notify->>User: confirmation email
```

---

## Validation Failure Path

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    actor User
    participant Portal  as Customer Portal
    participant APIGW   as API Gateway
    participant Lambda  as user-register-api

    User->>Portal: submits invalid email
    Portal->>APIGW: POST /users/register
    APIGW->>Lambda: invoke
    Lambda->>Lambda: validate (Zod) — FAILS
    Lambda-->>APIGW: 400 { error: "Invalid email" }
    APIGW-->>Portal: 400
    Portal-->>User: inline field error
```

---

## Duplicate Email Path

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    actor User
    participant Lambda  as user-register-api
    participant Cognito as Auth Platform (Cognito)

    User->>Lambda: POST /users/register (existing email)
    Lambda->>Cognito: createUser(email, password)
    Cognito-->>Lambda: UsernameExistsException
    Lambda-->>User: 409 { error: "Email already registered" }
```

---

## State Machine

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> FormFilled : User submits

    FormFilled --> ValidationFailed : Invalid input
    ValidationFailed --> FormFilled : User corrects

    FormFilled --> CognitoCreated : Zod passes
    CognitoCreated --> DuplicateError : Email exists
    DuplicateError --> [*] : 409 returned

    CognitoCreated --> ProfileSaved : DynamoDB write ok
    ProfileSaved --> EventEmitted : user.account.created
    EventEmitted --> ConfirmationSent : Notification platform
    ConfirmationSent --> [*] : 201 returned to user
```

---

## Platform components used

| Platform layer | Component                  | Role                                 |
| -------------- | -------------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| Infrastructure | API Gateway                | Routes POST /users/register          |
| Infrastructure | Lambda (user-register-api) | Business logic + validation          |
| Application    | Auth Platform (Cognito)    | User identity creation               |
| Data           | DynamoDB                   | Profile persistence                  |
| Data           | EventBridge                | user.account.created event           |
| Application    | Notification Platform      | Confirmation email                   |
| Product        | Customer Portal            | Registration UI (uses Design System) |
